brief.topic: The Pitch That Can Outlive Its Lowest Tone

s01: This sound contains four separate frequencies.
We will remove the lowest one.
The sound changes color, but you may still hear a similar low pitch.
The first mixture includes two hundred and twenty hertz, and three higher multiples.
The second contains only four hundred and forty, six hundred and sixty, and eight hundred and eighty.
There is no two hundred and twenty hertz tone in that second mixture.
Yet its whole pattern still repeats two hundred and twenty times each second.
Two, three, and four vibrations all fit into the same repeating interval.
Our sense of pitch can follow that shared repetition.
This is called the missing fundamental.
It separates the frequencies physically present from the pitch a listener may perceive.
Compare the two mixtures once more.
The shapes differ, but their repeating interval is the same.
Listeners and playback systems can change how convincing this sounds.
You do not have to hear the effect to follow the pattern.
Sometimes a relationship remains even after one part is taken away.

scenes.narration:
This sound contains four separate frequencies. We will remove the lowest one. The sound changes color, but you may still hear a similar low pitch.

The first mixture includes two hundred and twenty hertz, and three higher multiples. The second contains only four hundred and forty, six hundred and sixty, and eight hundred and eighty. There is no two hundred and twenty hertz tone in that second mixture.

Yet its whole pattern still repeats two hundred and twenty times each second. Two, three, and four vibrations all fit into the same repeating interval. Our sense of pitch can follow that shared repetition.

This is called the missing fundamental. It separates the frequencies physically present from the pitch a listener may perceive. Compare the two mixtures once more.

The shapes differ, but their repeating interval is the same. Listeners and playback systems can change how convincing this sounds. You do not have to hear the effect to follow the pattern. Sometimes a relationship remains even after one part is taken away.
